description: Read one Harris Teeter purchase in full — every item with quantity, price paid and savings, plus subtotal, coupons, tax and total. Pass a receiptKey from ht_list_orders. The site sometimes refuses this request (its bot protection); if so, open the purchase under My Purchases on harristeeter.com.

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands; "raw" returns the upstream payload unprojected. compact returns a projection of the documented fields; "full" returns the API payload minified; "raw" pretty-prints it.

name: ht_get_receipt
